functions.name: Emergency Shutdown
functions.description: Drops MCC-1 main enable, stopping every pump, on loss of the E-stop loop, a remote ESD demand or a fire panel alarm.
functions.notes: ESD_Active (rung 1) also feeds the ESD_Active input of every AOI_PumpInterlock instance.

functions.name: Pump P-101 High-Level Shutdown
functions.description: Stops P-101 when the wet well reaches high-high, or on any other trip cause wired to its interlock block.

alarm.notification: HMI alarm summary, Control Room A

functions.name: Pump P-102 Motor Overtemperature Interlock
functions.description: Blocks P-102 from running while its motor winding over-temperature relay is picked up.

functions.name: Pump P-103 Low-Pressure Trip
functions.description: Trips P-103 on low suction pressure (PSL-103) to protect the pump from cavitation.
functions.notes: P-103 is the only pump whose Press_Trip input is a suction low switch rather than discharge high.

functions.name: Tank T-101 Overflow Protection
functions.description: Closes inlet valve XV-101 when the wet well high-high float LSHH-101 trips.

functions.name: Compressor C-201 High-Pressure Shutdown
functions.description: Shuts down air compressor C-201 when receiver pressure switch PSH-201 trips.

alarm.notification: HMI alarm summary, Control Room A

functions.notes: Armed only while Safety_Enable is set at the HMI; the receiver relief valve is the independent layer.

functions.name: Tank T-101 High-High Level Alarm
functions.description: Annunciates T-101 high-high level to the control room so an operator can respond before overflow.

alarm.notification: HMI alarm summary, Control Room A

functions.name: Pump Start Permissive
functions.description: Allows pump starts only with MCC-1 enabled, the wet well below high-high and enough suction pressure.
functions.notes: The 12 psig suction setpoint gives NPSH margin at rated flow (calc NG-C-031).
